name: RouteMux
tagline: Reliability-first AI gateway: one API key for many providers. Pay only for success.
description: RouteMux is a reliability-first AI gateway. One API key and one endpoint reach models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, xAI, DeepSeek, Alibaba, Moonshot, Zhipu and MiniMax. It is compatible with OpenAI Chat Completions and Responses, Anthropic Messages and Google Vertex, so you keep your SDK and only change the base URL. Requests run over redundant upstream routes, and only successful requests are billed. Prepaid pay-as-you-go wallet with no subscription or seat fees. Built for developers and small engineering teams.
